LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: Legal entity identification as an alternate identification for a party.

Nationality.name: Nationality
Nationality.definition: Nationality of the investor or country of incorporation (for a company).

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

ProcessingIdentification.name: Processing Identification
ProcessingIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction for the party identified.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Provides additional information regarding the party.

IdentificationNationalityOfInvestorRule.definition: Identification and/or Nationality must be present.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.
